name: agent-desktop
description: Electron desktop agent IDE — Spring Boot backend + WebSocket

scripts.dev:full: pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/shared-types build && pnpm build:java && pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/desktop dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/shared-types build && pnpm build:java && pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/shared-types test && pnpm test:java && pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/desktop test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/desktop build:e2e && pnpm --filter @agent-desktop/desktop test:e2e
